title: Minnesota v. Dickerson (1993)
key_points: Holding: During a lawful frisk, an officer may seize an object whose contraband nature is immediately apparent by touch. Squeezing or manipulating an object after determining it is not a weapon exceeds the frisk.
officer_notes: Scenario: During a pat-down you feel a small lump in a jacket pocket. It is clearly not a weapon, so you roll it between your fingers to figure out what it is.
Takeaway: Once you know it's not a weapon, stop. Seize only if it is immediately recognizable as contraband.
